raw_description:
# Ice Causeway Travel Structure Overlay

A stylized ice-causeway overlay marker for a hex map. Simplified app-icon geometry.

Three interlocking rectangular ice slabs form a short bridge path across the icon center. The slabs should step slightly from lower-left to upper-right, with two tiny dark crack lines and small triangular notches to make them read as ice blocks, not a road. Flat saturated palette colors, sharp clean edges, generous padding. This represents a built physical travel structure over difficult or blocked terrain.

formatted_prompt.scene: Flat filled-vector app icon, three stepped rectangular ice slabs forming a short diagonal causeway bridge, centered on off-white canvas, vivid cyan-blue slabs with black crack details and white edge highlights.

subjects.description: Three interlocking rectangles stepping lower-left to upper-right, bold flat slabs with sharp corners, slightly offset to read as layered ice blocks
Two tiny angular crack lines and small triangular notches cut into slab surfaces, flat secondary shapes reading as fractured ice texture
